SELECT IndustryCodeName, IndustryName
FROM BDODealCards_Industry
WHERE IndustryCultureCode = '{% SubIndustryCultureCode %}'
and IndustrySiteID = '{% SiteContext.CurrentSiteID |(identity)GlobalAdministrator|(hash)4c87ec20da5d5500e604b06d4130c645fd7e8066c52863f4ef486c2f60f05d7c%}' 
ORDER BY IndustryName

SELECT GlobalIndustryCodeName, GlobalIndustryName
FROM BDODealCards_GlobalIndustry
ORDER BY GlobalIndustryName

resourceDescription: Manage site cultures, and site translations
Module to manage redirects through the Xperience CMS.  This package is for the Admin, not the MVC sites.1

formControlSettings.Query:
Select SiteID, SiteName from CMS_Site 
where 
 1 = {% CurrentUser.CheckPrivilegeLevel(UserPrivilegeLevelEnum.GlobalAdmin) ? 1 : 0 @%} 
 or SiteID in 
(select SiteID from CMS_UserSite where UserID = {% CurrentUser.UserID @%})

SELECT CultureCode, CultureName FROM CMS_Culture WHERE CultureID in (Select CultureID from CMS_SiteCulture where SiteID = {% Convert.ToInt(RedirectionSiteID.Value, 0) > 0 
	? Convert.ToInt(RedirectionSiteID.Value, 0) 
	: SiteContext.CurrentSiteID @%})

formControlSettings.WhereCondition: CultureID in (Select CultureID from CMS_SiteCulture where SiteID = {% Convert.ToInt(RedirectionSiteID.Value, 0) > 0 ? Convert.ToInt(RedirectionSiteID.Value, 0) : SiteContext.CurrentSiteID @%})
